value.rationale: This is the precise first diameter at which the known k>=9 sharp restricted-four-sumset inequality fails for k=8, not an arbitrarily selected slice. The original paper has one sharpness witness; determining the exact minimum and all equality configurations proves its exception has three distinct normalized structural types, refining the boundary of the recent theorem. The complete inverse classification is mathematically meaningful even though finite and without a general extension.
